title: Lacatski's warning that Yankee Blue was a psyop

tellings.quote: saying um Yankee Blue. That was a That was a psyop.

plain: Yankee Blue, a name that has circulated as a supposed secret UFO program, was a psyop, a deliberate deception, according to a warning the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell repeats to Michels. Corbell credits this to James Lacatski, a former Defense Intelligence Agency scientist who once ran a government UFO study, together with the Las Vegas journalist George Knapp. If so, at least one of the program names passed around in UFO circles would have been planted to mislead.
